items.description: If you laid every American who died from COVID-19 in a circle around Trump Tower, this is how big it would be. This mashup uses the CoronaTracker API to visualize COVID19 data.

This We Know lets you get local and explore government data about your community. Enter your city or zip code and get a list of facts. Click an individual item and be taken to a breakdown of the data. Finalist in Apps for America 2 contest.
Graphical analysis of job posts on Craigslist.org across all of US.

iKnowIt! is a simple iPhone app that uses the True Knowledge direct answer service API. Just pose a question and its powerful database will search over 500 million records to give you the perfect answer.
An online image editor that integrates nicely with Flickr.
Use TiVo to display your Photobucket photos on your home television.
